title: The Scrub Where Drainage Roots Deeper

features.name: the hidden root
features.desc-on-touch: Where the town's drainage has learned to live. The scrub roots down into the refuse and grows fertile from it.

features.name: the feral garden
features.desc-on-touch: Where things grow that have learned to love what humans discard. The landscape has become productive from hidden sources.

features.name: the gathering place
features.desc-on-touch: Where the outflow pools and learns to speak only to the scrub. The margin between what towns keep and what they release has become conscious.

features.name: the testimony
features.desc-on-touch: A sign the scrub has left. The landscape has learned to keep its own records of what flowed through.

inscription: what the town refuses to keep feeds the place it does not see; the scrub learns eloquence from hidden water
